items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Tsp Madras curry blend' to USDA SR Legacy 'Spices, curry powder'. The destination explicitly identifies a Madras curry spice blend, and the target's own immutable candidate evidence contains the USDA curry-powder record at rank 9. Confidence remains medium because Madras curry blends vary in the proportions of turmeric, coriander, cumin, chili, fenugreek, and other spices; this binding represents the closest standardized curry-powder nutrient profile and does not generalize to curry paste, curry sauce, curry roux, garam masala, or generic 'Curry'.
